card.name: Scattered linking words in general prose
card.fires_on: Mixed words in general web prose, such as 'also', 'through', 'of' after 'set', and 'standard' in 'standard of living'. No single word or setting is shared.

modes.label: Linking words within sentences
modes.description: Words like 'also', 'through' or 'of' that link a clause or noun phrase in historical or political prose.
modes.example: Lieutenant Luther,<< also>> of the artillery, was struck.

card.plain: It responds to a loose mix of ordinary words in non-medical history and civic text, with no pattern a clinician could use.
